newsitem.title: USA: Mobil begins oil output early at UK field.
newsitem.headline: Mobil begins oil output early at UK field.

text.p: Mobil Corp unit Mobil North Sea Ltd said Tuesday it had begun production at the Nevis field in the U.K. sector of the North Sea ahead of schedule.
It said initial estimated daily production was 13,500 barrels of oil and 11 million cubic feet of gas.

"Production from Nevis South will increase overall volumes through the Beryl Alpha platform to more than 100,000 barrels of oil each day," it said, referring to the Mobil-operated platform located off the shore of Scotland.
The unit said estimated recoverable reserves in Nevis South were 50 million barrels of crude oil, 1.8 million barrels of condensate and 175 billion cubic feet of natural gas.

The Mobil unit has a 29.5-percent interest in the field, while British Gas North Sea Holdings Ltd has 31.78 percent, Amerada Hess Ltd 22.72 percent, Enterprise Oil Plc 13 percent and OMV (UK) Ltd 3.25 percent.
